status: proposed_v3_baseline (adopted inside the implementation package; team ratification recorded in decision log)
method: Fixed benchmark anchors per normalized field. Values are derived from the frozen 2026-07 12-site cohort ranges, rounded OUTWARD to stable planning bounds so that (a) every current site scores inside [0,1], (b) adding or removing candidate sites cannot change an existing site's score, and (c) anchors remain plausible for the region's site classes. Where a regional benchmark exists (EV share) the fixed benchmark is kept from the legacy model.
fallback_rule: If a field has no anchor entry, scoring falls back to cohort min-max and the output carries anchor_fallback_fields listing them. Fallback use is a validation warning, not a silent default.

spare_capacity_kw.note: all cohort values 0 (unconfirmed); anchor allows future verified values without rescaling

install_cost_est_usd.note: derived field: trenching_ft * trench_cost_per_ft + service_upgrade_cost_usd; cohort max 52500, recomputed 2026-07-28 -- this note previously said 63750, which no site reaches. The anchor hi of 100000 is unchanged, so no score moves.
